# Hunter Foo Media

> Hunter Foo Media (legal name: HF Media Solution, Malaysia business registration IP0633909-U) builds positioning, content and follow-up systems for service businesses in Malaysia and Singapore: more clients, less busywork. Fully remote, English or Chinese. Not a recruitment agency. Founder: Hunter Foo.

- Website: https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/ (English) · https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/zh/ (中文) · https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/ms/ (Bahasa Melayu)

- Service area: Malaysia, Singapore (same service, delivered remotely)
- Delivery: about 28 days after complete materials; one-page quote after the diagnosis (what, how many days, how much)
- After delivery: 2 free revisions within 30 days; account management is a separate monthly fee

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/): AI automation, personal branding, social media & Reels — start with the one holding you back most
- [AI Automation](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/ai-automation/): for small teams stuck forwarding and chasing updates; fix the most annoying handover first, no software to buy first
- [Personal Brand](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/personal-brand/): for solo professionals and property agents; one clear line of positioning plus content themes
- [Social Media & Reels](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/services/social-reels/): for brands and professionals who keep going quiet; topics, captions and Reels
- [ChatGPT Ads](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/products/#chatgpt-ads): new; account setup, tracking (OpenAI pixel), ad copy, campaign management and reporting for ads shown below ChatGPT answers to Free and Go users; you approve every ad, no results guaranteed
- [Website building](https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/products/#website-building): new; Basic company website (Home, About, Services, Contact, WhatsApp button, mobile-friendly, optional EN/中文/BM, domain and HTTPS setup) or SEO + AEO/GEO (adds titles and meta descriptions, sitemap, Google and Bing indexing submission, page speed, Q&A/FAQ content, structured data, consistent company details, indexing check report); fees by written quote, no rankings promised
